title: [Bug]  schedule CQ offset invalid. offset=77, cqMinOffset=0, cqMaxOffset=74, queueId=1
body:
### Before Creating the Bug Report

- [X] I found a bug, not just asking a question, which should be created in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/discussions).

- [X] I have searched the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/issues) and [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/discussions)  of this repository and believe that this is not a duplicate.

- [X] I have confirmed that this bug belongs to the current repository, not other repositories of RocketMQ.


### Runtime platform environment

mac os(linux)

### RocketMQ version

5.1.0

### JDK Version

jdk8

### Describe the Bug

2023-07-25 10:33:49 ERROR BrokerControllerScheduledThread1 - schedule CQ offset invalid. offset=77, cqMinOffset=0, cqMaxOffset=74, queueId=1
2023-07-25 10:33:50 ERROR BrokerControllerScheduledThread1 - correct delay offset [ delayLevel 2 ] from 77 to 74

in reality
![image](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/assets/42484192/dfe19282-6e84-4f54-867d-6f13d1b8d8e7)

Offset corrections were made here
![image](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/assets/42484192/0fb97ac3-4793-4e75-a68d-d94ed0fadedf)
But it doesn't refresh to delayOffset.json

Then re-added in the delayOffset.json file for a corrective override
![image](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/assets/42484192/6964457e-2ef6-4d65-8f20-12779755043a)



### Steps to Reproduce

1. star broker slave
2. delete store file

### What Did You Expect to See?

no error

### What Did You See Instead?

error
2023-07-25 10:33:49 ERROR BrokerControllerScheduledThread1 - schedule CQ offset invalid. offset=77, cqMinOffset=0, cqMaxOffset=74, queueId=1
2023-07-25 10:33:50 ERROR BrokerControllerScheduledThread1 - correct delay offset [ delayLevel 2 ] from 77 to 74

_No response_
